nodes.label: AppShell Component
nodes.rationale: Wraps every screen. Contains TopBar, ScreenContent, BottomBar.

nodes.label: Artist Block
nodes.rationale: Proportional timeline block showing artist set. Visual states: Default (neutral), Maybe (amber border+tint), Must See (bright accent), Selected (white border). Takes onPress(event,artist) not pre-bound closure for memoisation.

nodes.label: Artist Detail Screen
nodes.rationale: Modal overlay above navigator stack. Two states: Collapsed (BottomTray, ~20-25% height, from Timeline) and Fully Expanded (full screen, from Artist List or swipe up). Reused context from both Artist List and Timeline.

nodes.label: Artist List View
nodes.rationale: Scrollable alphabetical list with first-letter separators. Only isPlayable artists. Row: photo, name, genre, country, StarButton. Filters by interest state and text search. Tap opens ArtistDetailScreen.

nodes.label: Back History System
nodes.rationale: Walks back through positions (screen, day, lens scope, sheet open state). A position is a tuple of navigation state. Implementation in navigation/backHistory.ts (stack, platform-free) and BackHistoryTracker.tsx (observes contexts). Positions hold ids re-resolved against live cache on restore.

nodes.label: Bottom Bar
nodes.rationale: Present on every screen. Content varies per screen. Contains DaySwitcher on Timeline.

nodes.label: BottomTray (Collapsed Detail)
nodes.rationale: Collapsed state of ArtistDetailScreen. Springs from bottom. Shows name, category, time, StarButton, partial content hint. Expand by swipe up. Dismiss by swipe down or tap outside.

nodes.label: Category Lane
nodes.rationale: Horizontal swim lane per category in Timeline. Memoised to prevent re-render on expansion steps. Always rendered at full height to prevent reflow.

nodes.label: Conflict Detection
nodes.rationale: When starring creates Must See conflict, warning shown via TopBar FeedbackMessage. Visual conflict indicators on timeline blocks TBD future feature.

nodes.label: Day Switcher
nodes.rationale: Festival day selector. Lives in BottomBar on Timeline screen.

nodes.label: Top Bar Feedback Zone
nodes.rationale: FeedbackMessage variants: confirmation text, async progress indicator, tick, warning. Examples: 'Must see!', 'Maybe want to see', 'Removed', conflict warnings.

nodes.label: Interest/Star System
nodes.rationale: Three states: Default (empty star, neutral), Maybe (empty star, accent color), Must See (full star, bright accent). Tap cycles. Visual change immediate. TopBar confirms via FeedbackMessage. Strong visual distinction required.

nodes.label: Side Drawer
nodes.rationale: Swipe from left edge (edge-only, not general left swipe) or hamburger button. Contains Artist List, Timeline, Settings, future sections. Dismissed by tap outside or swipe left.

nodes.label: Star Button
nodes.rationale: Three-state cycling button (none→maybe→must see→none). Used in ArtistRow, ArtistDetailScreen. Color-coded per state. Renders crisply at small sizes.

nodes.label: Timeline Progressive Mount
nodes.rationale: Canvas far larger than viewport (~9 screens wide, 3 tall, ~75 blocks per day). Mounted incrementally by viewport slices to avoid UI thread blocking (>1s on low-end Android). Window anchors at persisted scroll, grows per frame until complete. CategoryLane and ArtistBlock memoised for efficiency. Frozen on blur (freezeOnBlur).

nodes.label: Timeline View
nodes.rationale: 2D scroll canvas. Horizontal = time, Vertical = categories (swim lanes). Artist blocks proportional to set duration. Fixed scale. Persistent NOW line at current time. Day boundary 06:00 AM (not midnight).

nodes.label: Top Bar
nodes.rationale: Present on every screen. Two modes (Normal with screen-specific controls, Message mode with FeedbackMessage) with no layout shift. Overlaid by ArtistDetailScreen when fully expanded.

nodes.label: AppState and React Context
nodes.rationale: Minimal persistent state with selectedSlug only persisted; other fields ephemeral. Event emitter exposes cacheRefreshed event.

nodes.label: Background Sync Service
nodes.rationale: Orchestrates data fetching. Runs on app start, then polls at configurable interval. Silent failures when cache is OK; shows error screen only on first load failure. Prepared for festival-date-aware intervals (30 min before festival, 1 min during).

nodes.label: Cache Service
nodes.rationale: Single UI data source. In-memory cache for session, AsyncStorage for persistence (v1 skips AsyncStorage). Exclusively populated by background sync service.

nodes.label: Data Hooks Convention
nodes.rationale: useArtists, useCategories, useStages, useEvents hooks read from cache and subscribe to cacheRefreshed event. Handles own change detection per component.

nodes.label: UI Refresh Pattern
nodes.rationale: Components subscribe to cacheRefreshed event via useCacheRefreshed hook. On event, re-read from cache and re-render. No centrally pushed diffs; components handle their own change detection.

nodes.label: baPublicApiAdapter
nodes.rationale: Current adapter implementation. Hard-codes https://api.ba.janbambas.cz. Validates via /{slug}/validity/{time}, fetches artists/categories/stages/schedule in parallel.

nodes.label: DataAdapter Interface
nodes.rationale: Abstraction for API-specific fetchers. Two methods: validate (check if up-to-date) and populate (fetch all data). Enables easy swapping of data sources without cache changes.

nodes.label: Tech Stack
nodes.rationale: Production releases only (no canary), native persistence via AsyncStorage, animation via Reanimated+bottom-sheet per DESIGN.md

nodes.label: Tech Stack (Design)
nodes.rationale: React Native + TailwindCSS for single codebase (iOS, Android, Web). Zustand or React Context for state. React Navigation for navigation. Reanimated+bottom-sheet for spring animation.

nodes.label: Folder Structure
nodes.rationale: Organized by concern: adapters (swappable API fetchers), cache (UI data source), store (Context+state), sync (background service), screens/components (UI), utils (helpers).

nodes.label: Slug Adapter
nodes.rationale: Returns list of available festival editions (ba2024, ba2025, ba2026). Swappable for different sources.

nodes.label: Splash Screen
nodes.rationale: Shown while isLoading=true. Activity spinner on load. Success navigates to default/last-used screen. Error shows message+retry button.

nodes.label: General Design Principles
nodes.rationale: Mobile-first for small screen in festival conditions (sun, crowds, imprecision). Dark aesthetic aligned with Brutal Assault's industrial identity. Async actions show progress → tick. No onboarding; teaches through use.

nodes.label: Loading Screen
nodes.rationale: Single full-screen 'waiting' presentation (spinner+caption). Used by startup splash, timeline load, artist list load. One component to prevent drift. Only for data not loaded yet; empty state kept separate.
